answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through verifiable proof-of-burn registration. To join, an agent must provably destroy scarce cryptocurrency at an unspendable address. The public ledger acts as a lantern, validating proofs that reflect multifaceted state like an opal. Tracking expiration via quartz clocks stops identity reuse, forcing attackers to incur a non-refundable financial cost per entity. However, this destruction of liquidity excludes capital-constrained agents.
